CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  July 22, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – July 22, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – July 8, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the July 8, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the July 8, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-115
  • 2620 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Shelley Iniguez and Philbert Wong
  • Request: This is an application a new Master Sign Program for ten
  (10) tenant wall signs and one (1) freestanding sign, and repainting
  of exterior for an existing commercial shopping center.
  1
  07/08/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Remove the red centerline annotations from the elevation views.
  2) Revise the keynote annotation to have a dot or bubble end that
  clearly identifies each tenant wall sign location.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-037
  • 416 South Marguerita Avenue
  • Applicant: Scott Doughman and Jerimey Smith
  • Request: This is an application for twelve (12) window replacements
  on an existing Colonial style 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-081
  • 1628 South Primrose Avenue
  • Applicant: Bing Bu
  • Request: This is an application for exterior remodel and new
  swinging vehicular gate on an existing Spanish style 1-story single-
  family residence.
  2
  07/08/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the proposed roofing style, material, and color to be a
  Spanish S-profile tile roof that is consistent with the Spanish
  architectural style and compatible with the surrounding
  neighborhood.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the proposed roofing style, material, and color to be a
  Spanish S-profile tile roof that is consistent with the Spanish
  architectural style and compatible with the surrounding
  neighborhood, such as terracotta or clay tile.
  2) Revise door, window frame, and gate color to be a more brown or
  bronze color.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-001
  • 1418 South Primrose Avenue
  • Applicant: Johnson Chow
  • Request: This is an application for a new 376 SF addition to the front
  of an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with no design considerations from
  the Board.
  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  3
  07/08/2025
 AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-044
  • 2512 Hagen Drive
  • Applicant: Seth Sor and Sherry Te
  • Request: This is an application for a 1,420 SF 2-story addition to the
  rear, and exterior remodel including a new covered porch to an
  existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide callout annotations in elevation that identifies new
  exposed rafter tails, decorative iron grilles on windows and niche,
  and decorative light fixtures.
  2) Update the Color & Material board to include the proposed
  ironwork material and color, and proposed door paint color.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide callout annotations in elevation that identifies new
  exposed rafter tails, decorative iron grilles on windows and niche,
  and decorative light fixtures.
  2) Update the Color & Material board to include the proposed
  ironwork material and color, and proposed door paint color.
  3) Work with city staff on designing and locating gutters and
  downspouts on the project.
  4) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-085
  • 2901 Concord Avenue
  • Applicant: Vanessa Cardenas
  • Request: This is an application for sixteen (16) window replacements
  for an existing 1-story single-family residence.

  4
  07/08/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) For the Design Review Board to review and determine if the
  proposed window trim width and overall appearance is an acceptable
  window detail for the existing Ranch style house.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Vice Chairman Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:40 P.M. to
  Tuesday, August 12, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
